verdict.rationale: Cursor exposes a broad programmatic surface. The core agent is scriptable through the SDK, which runs 'the same agent that runs in the Cursor IDE, CLI, and web app'. There is also a headless CLI with JSON output and an ACP mode, a live Cloud Agents API with a published OpenAPI spec, and Admin, Analytics, AI Code Tracking, Bugbot and Origin APIs. Parity with the UI is not documented, though: the Cloud Agents API is in beta, v1 webhooks are 'coming soon', several APIs are Enterprise-only, and automations are documented only as created via the Agents Window, cursor.com/automations or the /automate skill. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, API-based automation creation, v1 webhooks, non-Enterprise access to the admin and analytics APIs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
